question: Among the already source-authorized recovered raw predecessor objects, which objects are exact connected-mixed Boolean raw instances under the frozen Schaefer semantic classification, and does any such object remain unadmitted after the current sealed exact portfolio including EXACT_TRANSPOSITION_ORBIT_COUNT_QUOTIENT?
claim_ceiling: This census can localize the first currently source-authorized connected-mixed raw obstruction or report that none exists in the frozen recovered corpus. It cannot prove general connected-mixed tractability, arbitrary unseen-invariant discovery, general SAT in P, P=NP, P!=NP, or a general lower bound.

source_list_freeze.rule: Reuse verbatim the complete deterministic 26-entry source inventory already preregistered by the v3.21 raw-predecessor acquisition census. No constructor may be added, removed, reordered, or selected based on this census result.

raw_semantic_authority.rule: Only canonical variables, constraint scopes, and explicit allowed Boolean tuples are truth authority. Constructor names, carrier labels, cached statuses, family labels, hints, and previous solver results are not semantic authority.

connected_mixed_eligibility.E1_one_constraint_bearing_incidence_comp: Build the exact bipartite variable-constraint incidence graph from canonical scopes. All constraints must lie in one connected component.
connected_mixed_eligibility.E2_distinct_relation_surface: Use raw_relation_basis.relation_surface over canonical allowed tuples; duplicate semantic relations count once.
connected_mixed_eligibility.E3_each_relation_locally_schaefer_admiss: For every distinct relation, raw_relation_basis.classify_each must have at least one true predicate among ZERO_VALID, ONE_VALID, HORN, DUAL_HORN, BIJUNCTIVE, AFFINE.
connected_mixed_eligibility.E4_no_single_global_schaefer_basis: raw_relation_basis.classify_language over the complete distinct relation surface must have every frozen basis predicate false, equivalently candidate_bases is empty and status is OPEN_NO_SCHAEFER_BASIS.
connected_mixed_eligibility.E5_mixed_not_intrinsically_non_schaefer: A raw object containing any distinct relation with no local frozen Schaefer basis is excluded from the connected-mixed obstruction class and recorded separately as INTRINSICALLY_NON_SCHAEFER_RELATION_PRESENT.
connected_mixed_eligibility.E6_label_blind: Eligibility is computed only from raw scopes and tuples. No OR2, XOR, affine, Horn, carrier, family, or expected-status label may be trusted.

prior_raw_sha_closure_receipt.rule: Reuse only exact prior closure statements keyed to the same canonical raw SHA/constructor alias. Do not invent adapters to mechanisms with incompatible input contracts.

factorized_feedback_rule: The sealed factorized-feedback mechanism is retained as a regression/theorem binding. It may close a census object only if an already sealed exact representation binding maps that same source object into its frozen obligation contract. This census may not create a new representation adapter merely to force applicability.
log_alien_adapter_rule: For an eligible raw object, OR2 and EVEN_XOR3 identities may be derived only by exact equality of arity and allowed-tuple sets to the sealed relations. Both base/alien orientations may be tested deterministically. L must be the canonical explicit raw JSON byte length or a smaller frozen charge; admission requires q^k<=L exactly as in the sealed theorem. No family label from the constructor may be used.
orbit_rule: The frozen V1 orbit-count candidate receives the unchanged canonical raw object with only variables and constraints. No new family/carrier labels may be injected. Its OPEN result is not a failure; it simply means the orbit mechanism does not close that object.
zero_obstruction_interpretation: Only the frozen recovered 26-entry source corpus is exhausted under the applicable current sealed exact portfolio. This does not prove general connected-mixed tractability and does not license a new theorem or general SAT promotion.
first_obstruction_interpretation: Freeze the first canonical raw SHA, all constructor aliases/source provenance, exact raw object, Schaefer fingerprints, applicable-mechanism receipts, and resource metrics. Do not design, tune, or execute a new carrier until a separate successor preregistration is frozen.
